items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: No, I forgot him. I don't know anything. I think he must be some kinder, Johnny.

ctx.x: You know, I wanted to ask you, I know there's a Johnny Gould, but who was Freddie Gould? Freddie Gould. Did you know him? He's a guitar player? I don't know anything about him.
Freddie Gould. No, I forgot him. I don't know anything. I think he must be some kinder, Johnny. Yeah, yeah. Must be the young ones that just come up around. Yeah, yeah.
Oh, you told Russell about going to the music stall on Charter Street? Oh, on Charter Street, yeah. And you'd buy those 25-cent music books?
